rationale: Uphold this exact nine-unit whole-case AI research claim. Against both original pages, the inventory preserves the policy, definitions, descriptive baseline, independent §3(b) encouragement, distinct §4(a)/(b) subjects and all §5 safeguards. I accept the source-specific legal reading that these nonbinding presidential policy/encouragement provisions were not automatically extinguished by possible prior USPS consideration, an enactment by a different body, or passage of a recommended deadline; they contain no performance-dependent end. On that reading first prospective legal cessation is EO14005 §14(a) on January25,2021, not a claim that USPS performed nothing or all downstream effects vanished. Savings and counterevidence remain bounded and accurately separated from external procurement law. The FAR corrected effective-date chronology is supported, and 31 exact source references plus35 manifest entries match. This is a new independent lifecycle verdict, not an extension of the historical status verdict.
